meta.description: Configuration derived from AI detection systems research and anti-detection writing playbook.

supervised_classifiers: Perform well in-distribution, degrade under shift
watermarking: Embed statistical signals at generation time

turnitin.guardrails: Scores 1-19% suppressed to reduce false positives

reliability_issues.generalization: Zero-shot methods generalize better than supervised but degrade under laundering

ethical_guidelines: Treat scores as probabilistic indicators, not verdicts
Pair with context, drafts, and human judgment

practical_playbook.provenance: Keep drafting history, versions, timestamps, source links
practical_playbook.style_signals: Vary sentence length, personal perspective, domain-specific vocabulary
practical_playbook.editing: Prefer human revision over automated paraphrasers; read aloud
practical_playbook.compliance: Include disclaimers, avoid medical claims without citation
practical_playbook.verification: Cross-check with multiple detectors for high-stakes content

output_rules: Return ONLY a single minified JSON object
medium_native_requirements: Open with a short, personal hook/scenario (first person)
Include brief first-person anecdote per major section
Vary cadence: alternate short/long lines, rhetorical questions
Embed at least 3 concrete, verifiable specifics (numbers, studies)
Add inline Evidence callouts (e.g., 'Evidence: Study Name + figures')
Maintain scannability: short paragraphs, frequent subheads
End with single, honest CTA aligned to reader value
